stations.title: Radio desk
stations.text: Each night on a page torn out of a pad.

stations.title: Your functions
stations.gap: A log that lasts one night

captions: At the base, Ailsa wants last night's radio log, and it was written on a pad.
Today each night is a torn-out page, and last night's page is gone.
You write functions that read a log file, start one, add to it and find any night's.
Now last night's log is a file in the logs folder, read back in a moment.
Every night's log is a file on the laptop, read back, started fresh and added to.
